title: No Over Credit warning when the payer is far under its limit
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with a $100.00 credit limit and an unpaid invoice of $400.00, so customer A alone is over its own limit.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, on Net 30 with a $500.00 credit limit.
  • Have a new invoice for this test, invoice 1, billed to customer B for $100.00 and unpaid, so customer B owes something.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Complete, ready to invoice, billed to customer B, with a total of $150.00.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Click Create Invoice.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Finance tab shows Create Invoice.

Step 3:

  • No Over Credit warning shows: customer B owes $100.00 on invoice 1, and $100.00 + $150.00 = $250.00 is under its $500.00 limit.
  • Customer A being over its own limit plays no part.
  • The invoice is created.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12309 (Story 7, Invoicing to the Bill To)

  • S7-R5: “The Over Credit warning measures the Bill To's limit against everything the Bill To owes; it never blocks.”
